history.text: 學 is the traditional counterpart of standardized simplified 学. The graphic path from early forms to either modern shape is not established here.

A later lexicographic account describes 學 as an abbreviated seal-script form of 斆, which it analyzes as 教 and 冖 with 𦥑 supplying the sound. This received account does not confirm the structure of earlier forms.

learner/components.text: ⺍ is the top subpart of 学’s upper assembly, with 冖 below it; the assembly’s function is unresolved.
冖 is the middle part of 学’s upper assembly; its shape alone does not establish a roof meaning or ancient role here.
子 is visible in 学. One proposal says it was added to 學 in Western Zhou forms to mark a child learner; its present-day function remains unresolved.
